summary: Copies surface data from a source into a destination D3D texture surface across mip levels and cubemap faces. Validates the destination surface type via its vtable (3 = 2D texture, 4 = 3D volume, 5 = cubemap); when a4 is -1 it auto-selects the mip flag from power-of-2 dimension checks (5 for auto-generate, 0 otherwise, or the filter-flag fallback 524292 when dimensions are not power-of-2). Iterates faces (1 for 2D/3D, 6 for cubemap) and mip levels, locking each surface through the vtable and blitting with SurfaceBlitOperation (0050099C) or Direct3DTextureVertexBufferInit (00500B42), then releasing the locked surfaces through the vtable. Returns the sentinel error value -2005530516 on a NULL surface, unsupported surface type, or out-of-range mip level; otherwise 0 or the last lock/blit result.

local_names.a1: destination D3D texture surface (vtable object); also carries the locked-surface handles during the loop
local_names.a2: source surface data copied by the blit operations
local_names.v27: surface type queried through the vtable

operations.description: If the destination surface a1 is NULL, return -2005530516
Query surface type through vtable slot +40; if the type is not 3, 4 or 5 return -2005530516
When a4 is -1, query the surface descriptor through vtable slot +56 to test whether width/height (and depth for volume) are exact powers of two
Auto-mip flag selection from the power-of-two checks: set a4 = 5 when all dimensions are power-of-two, a4 = 0 otherwise, or a4 = 524292 (filter-flag fallback) when auto-selection cannot be used
Query the mip-map count through vtable slot +52; if the requested mip level a3 is >= the count, return -2005530516 (a3 == -1 is first clamped to 0)
Outer loop over faces (1 for types 3 and 4, 6 for cubemap type 5); inner loop over mip levels from a3 upward, locking each destination surface through vtable slot +60
Blit the locked surface: SurfaceBlitOperation for 2D and cubemap faces, Direct3DTextureVertexBufferInit for volume slices; a failure result aborts the loops
Release each locked surface through vtable slot +8 after the blit, and again on the cleanup path when an error aborts the loops
Return 0 on full success, -2005530516 on the early validation errors, otherwise propagate the last lock/blit result
Invoked by DirectXDeviceSurfaceCreationWithFormatCapability (0053FD40) during surface creation with format capability checks
